traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets disruption. Attraction to unconventional ideas and systems of thought. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Seen as eccentric or a crank, no matter the merit of the idea. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for growth against disruption, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the growth/disruption form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: A popular new market sends prices and demand moving faster than housing, staffing, supply, or regulation can follow. Early users gain options while everyone arriving later faces shortages, new fees, or rules written after the rush began. Jupiter keeps increasing the scale and confidence, while Uranus overturns the system that made growth predictable. The square turns each breakthrough into another source of instability the existing structure cannot absorb. The opening may reward early participants while leaving everyone else paying more to adapt.
